name: Uncle Carlin
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Sometimes, when it's nighttime, I can hear my Uncle Carlin crying.  It sounds like he's far away, to the east.

I hope he's not crying for me!  adventurer, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?

If you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam!  That story's so funny!
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've seen Pamela? She's alive?

She's dead? No! Oh, Pamela! Why does your spirit still suffer in this world. Why are you perished, while fortune keeps me alive? In an instant I would switch places with you and wander dead Darrowshire, a ghost and alone!

Ah, but this news cannot change fate. Thank you, adventurer. Now my duty, my duty to revenge, burns hot as ever.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 55 to 56, 14,700 XP in all.

quests.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
quests.objectiveText: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
